question: Which of the following ground hosted the final of the Ranji Trophy 2022/23?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Eden Gardens.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Ranji Trophy 2022/23 final was held at Eden Gardens, **Kolkata**, from 16th to 19th February 2023.
 
• The match was contested between Saurashtra and Bengal.
 
• **Saurashtra** emerged victorious, defeating Bengal by 9 wickets to claim their second Ranji Trophy title.
